text: "I don't ask questions. I got it for 6. You get that plus risk and labor. It needed cleaning."

speaker: Rhetoric
text: There's a mask behind you. Shift your weight aside and let the decorations do the work. He doesn't like you. Have him focus on something else, then say something that sounds like a reason. I have a perfect spool of nonsense fresh and ready.

speaker: Geno
text: Small crystals and rusted metal sit on temporary shelving. The most prized possession in the shop is an account book behind the front desk. Though only under an awning, the inside of the shop feels like the inside of a building. 2 men on opposite sides of the counter are haggling over an ornate dagger. Both are rough an sandy.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: Vengeance. That is what you are here to do. You lost your weapon in the attack last week. You need a new one. A blade can be your second spine and will give you the implements with which to enact your emotions.

speaker: Nervous System
text: Situation Report. You've reported the incident to the palace guard, but they seemed uninterested.

choices: Is that really how it went down?
speaker: Skeletal System
text: You gave them a strong talking to. How dare they not understand your struggle.

speaker: Integumetary System
text: You heard a small child's voice chant "silent square, don't go there" twice over yesterday. Their mother taught them. You are not with your family and had no trouble with the path. Wind drafts in from the desert and through your hair. Early morning dew from the forest above drips down. If you weren't in such a hurry, the quiet market square before you would be a safe spot to reflect.

speaker: Soul
text: You left after losing a sad argument with a stranger.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: It was [i]inconclusive[/i] at worst.

speaker: Nervous System
text: Doesn't matter. After that, you found a place to stay in the center of East Breach, a hostel in one of the old towers. You have enough money to stay there for 5 days plus food.

speaker: Body
text: You are a tourist, however. You aren't too young to be here, but you look too young to be here. Someone might ask if you got lost from your parents.

speaker: Power
text: You will be fine as long as you assert what you need.

speaker: The Silent Square
text: This area of the palace is still a public area, but an array crumbling stone steps separate it from the tourism section. So, why are there shops? Well, there's a tacit a agreement between a merchant guild and the palace guard to not interfere in this area. No tourists means no public risk. And so, it's known as the silent square.

speaker: Power
text: That uncertainty is your weakness. I do recommend having a weapon, and while what you do with it is up to you, just make sure it's what you want.

speaker: Soul
text: Then let's do what we can. Get leads. Get allies. Prioritize it but don't move quickly and break yourself in the process.

speaker: Power
text: Fine. But lets see through what you started here. Keep cooperating with forces, stay close to East Breach for fast communication, until there aren't any leads left, then go home.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: You shiver with anticipation.

text: After checking in, very late last night, you resolved to find a replacement for your stolen dagger here, the "Lower Side" of the breach.

speaker: Cage
text: I look down. Beneath me. I see a picture of a big house, who's there?

text: A little blue bird in a cage. It's not in the house, though.

text: The eyes of a suspicious Bandit peer over the desk of your shop. At the same moment, glare from the desert morning pierces the clouds. Your eyes are forced open. Stay alert.
